info.title: SeruendeshAI API
info.description: RAG walking assistant for Astana: 1–3 grounded recommendations with why / what to do, opening-hours confidence, honest source labels and an optional mini-route.

get.summary: Current user; guests get 200 {"user": null} (no 401 noise in the browser console)

schema.title: Response Me Api Auth Me Get

delete.summary: Delete my account and all my data

schema.title: Response Saved List Api Me Saved Get

post.summary: Set a new password with a reset token

get.summary: Event details including all source links
Find an address or place in Astana (for the saved home), rounded to ~100 m

post.summary: Themed walks from the user's place: 3–6 ready mini-routes

get.summary: City Insights: k-anonymous demand by ~1 km cell, intent and time

post.summary: Recommendations around a known place recognised in a photo (multipart form)
post.description:
The photo is decoded with a pixel cap, stripped of EXIF (GPS is never read), downscaled to 1024 px and
re-encoded before the LLM picks a place from a closed list; nothing is stored.

image.description: JPEG / PNG / WebP, up to 8 MB

landmark.description: Optional fallback landmark key if the photo is not recognised

post.summary: Route from the user (rounded GPS or a landmark) to one recommended place

422.description: no usable start (GPS outside Astana and no landmark)

get.summary: POIs around a point for the map (brief)

schema.title: Response Api Pois Api Pois Get

post.summary: A visitor's mark on a place (closed, wrong hours, 👍). Stored as day × place × kind counters only; «closed» marks can lower trust in «open», never the other way.

engine.title: Engine
engine.description: The auxiliary judge: OpenAI Decisions API and its model

intent.title: Intent
intent.description: Yes/no questions about the request (with_kids, indoor, night, quiet, unusual, about_city) and their probabilities

intent_applied.title: Intent Applied
intent_applied.description: Intent answers that changed the search

dropped.title: Dropped
dropped.description: Places left out as a clear misfit

match.title: Match
match.description: Probability 0–1 that the place fits the request

notice.title: Notice
notice.description: Indicates that the displayed text is a shortened source excerpt

FoodRequirement.title: FoodRequirement
FoodRequirement.description: An explicit user wish, with the original input span retained for audit.

llm.title: Llm
llm.description: Configured provider is not verified readiness

lat.title: Lat
lat.description: Latitude; the client should round to 3 decimals (~100 m)

lon.title: Lon
lon.description: Longitude; the client should round to 3 decimals

HomePlace.title: HomePlace
HomePlace.description: The user's home as the client keeps it (device / bot memory), rounded to ~100 m. Never stored by the API.

usage.description: Tokens and estimated cost of all LLM calls of this request

cost_usd.title: Cost Usd
cost_usd.description: Estimated USD from the price table in config; null = unknown model price

lat.title: Lat
lat.description: Latitude; the client should round to 3 decimals (~100 m)

lon.title: Lon
lon.description: Longitude; the client should round to 3 decimals

url.title: Url
url.description: Leaflet raster tile template ({z}/{x}/{y}, {r} for retina)

data_url.title: Data Url
data_url.description: A calmer style for data maps (City Insights)

password_reset_email.title: Password Reset Email
password_reset_email.description: SMTP is configured: password reset by email works

map.description: Styled basemap when a MapTiler key is configured; null = OpenStreetMap

label.title: Label
label.description: Human text in the response language, e.g. «Открыто до 22:00 (данные OSM)»

next_change.title: Next Change
next_change.description: Local HH:MM of the next open/close change, if known

recognized.title: Recognized
recognized.description: True when a known place was identified confidently enough to search around it

place_id.title: Place Id
place_id.description: Landmark key (GET /api/meta) or POI id the photo shows

description.title: Description
description.description: Short description of the photo by the AI

probability.title: Probability
probability.description: Decisions API probability for the recognised place; null when it did not answer or chose a different place

service_results.title: Service Results
service_results.description: Source-bound services, routes, fares and dated departures; distinct from POIs

ideas.title: Ideas
ideas.description: AI-generated micro-activities (source=generated), anchored to a recommended place

considered.title: Considered
considered.description: A few places that were rejected and why (transparency)

off_topic.title: Off Topic
off_topic.description: The query is not about places/walks in Astana: no recommendations, see notes

navigate_to.title: Navigate To
navigate_to.description: Directions request ('маршрут до …'): poi_id the client should route to right away

query.title: Query
query.description: Free text in RU/KK/EN, e.g. «Я возле Байтерека, хочу погулять час» (long text is truncated)

lang.title: Lang
lang.description: UI language; null = detect from the query

channel.title: Channel
channel.description: Client surface; `telegram` gets short chat-style texts. Facts and safety rules are the same

location.description: Approximate user position (rounded). Server rounds again.

location_label.title: Location Label
location_label.description: What the user typed for this start (an address the client geocoded, e.g. «Кенесары 40»); shown back, never sent to the LLM

landmark.title: Landmark
landmark.description: Landmark key or name from GET /api/meta instead of GPS

home.description: Saved home; used when the text says «от дома / рядом с домом» or use_home=true

use_home.title: Use Home
use_home.description: Start from the saved home (the «🏠 Дом» choice)

service_id.title: Service Id
service_id.description: Previous service context for a relevant follow-up; a new topic takes precedence

food_context.title: Food Context
food_context.description: Previous user food requirements, reused only for an unambiguous refinement; never venue facts

time_budget_min.title: Time Budget Min
time_budget_min.description: Total time the user has (null = from text or 60)

profile.description: Team contract §3.3 profile (with_kids, tourist, accessibility, group_size)

with_child.title: With Child
with_child.description: Overrides profile.with_kids; null = detect from text

want_route.title: Want Route
want_route.description: Ask for a 2–3 stop mini-route (default: auto)

now.title: Now
now.description: ISO datetime override for tests, e.g. 2026-10-18T19:30:00+05:00

weather.description: Weather override for tests (null = live Open-Meteo)

refine.title: Refine
refine.description: Follow-up refinements of the previous request: closer, no_coffee, indoor

service_results.title: Service Results
service_results.description: Source-bound services, routes, fares and dated departures; distinct from POIs

ideas.title: Ideas
ideas.description: AI-generated micro-activities (source=generated), anchored to a recommended place

considered.title: Considered
considered.description: A few places that were rejected and why (transparency)

off_topic.title: Off Topic
off_topic.description: The query is not about places/walks in Astana: no recommendations, see notes

navigate_to.title: Navigate To
navigate_to.description: Directions request ('маршрут до …'): poi_id the client should route to right away

poi_id.title: Poi Id
poi_id.description: POI id (osm:w123 / wd:Q123 / ov:...) or idea-N for AI ideas

distance_m.title: Distance M
distance_m.description: Straight-line (haversine) distance from the start, metres

travel_min.title: Travel Min
travel_min.description: Travel minutes along the real street network (walk) or road estimate (car)

source.title: Source
source.description: poi_data = collected dataset; generated = AI idea

source_url.title: Source Url
source_url.description: Exactly the dataset source (OSM / Wikidata / Wikipedia page) or null

rating.title: Rating
rating.description: Rating (1–5) from an open source when known, else null

website.title: Website
website.description: The place's own website, if known

match.title: Match
match.description: Probability 0–1 that the place fits the request, from the OpenAI Decisions API check; null when the check did not run (no key, timeout)

category_detail.title: Category Detail
category_detail.description: Fine-grained category key (33 types), see GET /api/meta

walk_distance_m.title: Walk Distance M
walk_distance_m.description: Network walking distance (car: estimated road distance)

arrival_at.title: Arrival At
arrival_at.description: Planned local arrival time for a route stop

departure_at.title: Departure At
departure_at.description: Planned local departure time for a route stop

leave_by.title: Leave By
leave_by.description: HH:MM to leave this place to keep the user's deadline (flight etc.)

return_min.title: Return Min
return_min.description: Travel from this alternative to the deadline destination;0 if no deadline return

data_sources.title: Data Sources
data_sources.description: Where the facts come from: osm, wikidata, wikipedia, overture, ticketon, sxodim

popularity.title: Popularity
popularity.description: 0..1 proxy from Wikipedia/Wikidata signals and data richness

features.title: Features
features.description: Confirmed amenities in the response language (Wi-Fi, terrace, ...)

badges.title: Badges
badges.description: indoor, outdoor, kids, hidden_gem, event, popular, night, free

description.title: Description
description.description: Short description (Wikipedia extract or facts from tags)

description_url.title: Description Url
description_url.description: Where the description comes from: the Wikipedia article or the cited source page

photo.description: Real photo from Wikimedia Commons; null -> category cover

structured_facts.title: Structured Facts
structured_facts.description: Accepted branch facts with source and validity

menu_items.title: Menu Items
menu_items.description: Published menu entries; delivery prices do not imply dine-in prices

prices.title: Prices
prices.description: Source-reported price/check with currency, unit and channel

total_min.title: Total Min
total_min.description: Travel + fixed visits + back_min (if return travel has no leg)

back_min.title: Back Min
back_min.description: Deadline return travel not represented by route legs

location.description: Rounded GPS of the user (3 decimals); preferred origin

landmark.title: Landmark
landmark.description: Landmark key/name when GPS is unavailable

RouteRequest.title: RouteRequest
RouteRequest.description: A walking/driving route from the user (rounded GPS, or a landmark when GPS is off) to one place.

geometry.title: Geometry
geometry.description: network = along the walking graph; straight = estimate

polyline.title: Polyline
polyline.description: [[lat, lon], ...] from the user to the place

origin.description: The start actually used, rounded to ~100 m

now.title: Now
now.description: ISO datetime used for opening hours (Astana, UTC+5)

parsed_from_query.title: Parsed From Query
parsed_from_query.description: What the system understood from the text (categories, needs, deadline)

funnel.title: Funnel
funnel.description: POIs total -> within reach -> after filters -> shown

ai_check.description: What the auxiliary Decisions API judge answered (null when it did not run)

max_outdoor_min.title: Max Outdoor Min
max_outdoor_min.description: Comfortable continuous minutes outdoors derived from feels-like/wind/air

us_aqi.title: Us Aqi
us_aqi.description: US air quality index (CAMS via Open-Meteo); ≥101 shortens outdoor time

WeatherOverride.title: WeatherOverride
WeatherOverride.description: Test override of live weather (reproducible evaluations).
